Welcome to Oslo! My name is Erik, and I drive this bus every day. Oslo is the biggest city in Norway, but it's a small city, really. Only seven hundred thousand people. Is it the most expensive city in Europe? Maybe! A coffee here is eight dollars. The best time to visit is June. The days are the longest of the year, and at eleven at night it is still light. The coldest month is January. Don't come in January! And the best view of the city? Go to the top of the old ski jump. It's the highest place in Oslo, and the view is amazing.

Good morning! Welcome to the oldest fish market in Oslo. Here you can find the freshest fish in the city. It comes from the sea every morning at five. Our most popular dish is the fish soup. It's also the cheapest: only ten dollars a bowl. The best day to come is Saturday, because there is music and the market is the busiest. But for a quiet lunch, come on Tuesday. And please, try our cake. My mother makes it, and I think it's the best cake in Norway!

We climbed three hundred stairs to the top of the tower. Claire was the slowest, but the view was the most beautiful of the trip. On Tuesday we walked by the lake. It was the coldest day of my life. Yesterday I had the fish soup at the market. It was the cheapest and the best meal of the trip.
